description: This file generates the detail view page for a module in the vtiger CRM system, setting up Smarty template variables and including related data and permissions.

classes.name: $focus
classes.description: An instance of the current module class, representing the record being viewed.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used for rendering the view.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks and returns the toolbar buttons for the current module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID for the current module.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Gets the display name of the entity based on module and record ID.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves update information for the record.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into separate arrays for fields, types, and labels.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation data for database fields.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for actions like EditView and Delete.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related lists for the module and record.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Gets the block layout for the detail view.
